PC-Gehäuse (Mini-ITX)

https://makerworld.com/de/models/2261082-pc-case-mini-itx?from=search#profileId-2463570

PC Сase based on a Mini-ITX motherboard.

 

SIZES

- width – 215 mm;

- depth – 215 mm;

- height (with legs) – 95 mm.

The hole for the button is 12.5 mm. The hole for the power connector is 8.5 mm.

 

IMPORTANT!!!

1. The installation of the legs is mandatory, otherwise the ventilation of the housing will be disrupted.

2. The maximum height of the CPU cooler is 70 mm.

3. Check the dimensions of the components and the power of the DC-12V-24Pin-ATX Adapter several times and very carefully.

 

PRINT

1. 100% infill;

2. To print the Base, you need to enable support;

3. I recommend printing the legs from TPU.

 

ASSEMBLING

1. Attach the legs to double-sided adhesive tape.

2. The motherboard and the case cover are fixed using self–tapping screws with an external diameter of 3.5 mm (at least 4 mm, but I haven't tried it).

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 100% infill
- Filament: PETG (#000000), PETG (#FFFFFF)
